region.title: Radar Coverage Region
region.description: Select geographical bounding box for live ADS-B flight transponder scanning.

maxFlights.title: Max Flights to Extract
maxFlights.description: Maximum number of live flights to record in dataset.

searchCallsign.title: Filter by Specific Callsign / Airline Code
searchCallsign.description: Optional search term for specific aircraft callsign (e.g. RAM, UAE, BAW, AFR, DLH).

airportIcaoForFids.title: Airport ICAO for FIDS Timetable
airportIcaoForFids.description: Airport code to extract departure/arrival FIDS boards (e.g. GMMN, OMDB, LFPG, EGLL, KJFK).

includeConflictZones.title: Include Conflict Airspace CZIB Bulletins
includeConflictZones.description: Extract active global war zones and aviation risk notices.

includeMetarWeather.title: Include Aerodrome METAR Weather
includeMetarWeather.description: Extract decoded METAR winds, visibility, ceiling, and crosswind runway hazards.

apiKey.title: Apify API Token / Custom Key
apiKey.description: Optional Apify API token or custom authentication key for MCP and programmatic triggers.
